column1: # Side-on profiles for the ship and submarine blocks.
# The previous set mixed aerial obliques, bow-on views and one ceremony
# close-up. A recognition cue that names the silhouette is worthless over a
# photograph that does not show it, so these are all beam or near-beam views
# with the whole hull in frame.
# Typhoon is not listed: the side-on candidates for it are licensed
# "Attribution" with the author recorded as "Bellona Foundation?" — a licence
# that requires attribution over an author Commons itself is unsure of.
# Oscar II is an oblique on purpose: its diagnostic is beam width without a
# hump, and the one true beam view is a 1983 reconnaissance scan in which the
# width cannot be seen at all.
